crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

children.name: Ledger Anomaly Detection
children.blurb: Ledger anomaly detection is the practice of finding entries, balances, and patterns in accounting records that depart from expected behavior.

children.name: Substantive Testing at Full Coverage
children.blurb: Substantive testing at full coverage means applying audit procedures to every transaction or record in a population rather than a sample.

children.name: Inventory Observation and Valuation
children.blurb: This page covers the use of artificial intelligence in the continuous audit and assurance of inventory observation and valuation.

children.name: Going Concern Analysis
children.blurb: Going concern analysis in continuous audit and assurance assesses whether a company can meet its obligations for at least twelve months from the reporting date.

children.name: Internal Control Testing
children.blurb: Internal control testing is the process of evaluating whether controls over financial reporting, operations, and compliance are designed appropriately and operating effectively.

sections.body: Continuous audit and assurance is the use of AI to monitor financial records, transactions, and controls on an ongoing basis rather than only at period end. In practice, AI systems scan ledgers for unusual patterns, flag transactions that deviate from expected behavior, and help auditors decide where to look first. They can test entire populations of transactions instead of relying only on samples, which changes the economics of substantive testing. For inventory, AI can combine computer vision, sensor data, and records to check counts and valuation assumptions. Going concern analysis uses models to track cash flow, covenant, and market signals over time. Internal control testing uses automation to check whether approvals, segregation of duties, and reconciliation steps actually happened.
sections.heading: What this covers

sections.body: Some parts are more mature than others. Ledger anomaly detection is widely deployed, but it produces alerts that still need human judgment, and false positives remain a practical burden. Full coverage substantive testing is technically possible for structured data, yet messy formats, legacy systems, and incomplete audit trails limit how far it can go. Inventory observation has benefited from drones, cameras, and computer vision, but valuation still depends on assumptions that models cannot verify on their own. Going concern analysis is harder because it requires forward looking judgment, and AI can miss sudden shocks or management intent. Internal control testing can be automated for routine checks, but complex controls, manual overrides, and weak documentation keep many tests partly manual, and the wider atlas tracks 215 compliance and regulation pages, which reflects how often audit evidence and regulatory expectations overlap.
sections.heading: Where the work stands

sections.body: The pages in this section follow the audit workflow from raw data to judgment. Ledger Anomaly Detection is the entry point for finding unusual transactions and prioritizing follow up. Substantive Testing at Full Coverage explains how AI changes sample based testing into population level testing and what that means for evidence quality. Inventory Observation and Valuation covers the physical and valuation side, where sensors and images meet accounting estimates. Going Concern Analysis deals with the forward looking question of whether an entity can continue, and it is the most judgment heavy page here. Internal Control Testing closes the loop by examining whether the controls that produce reliable records are working, and a reader can move through them in that order or jump to the page that matches the audit stage they care about.
